players.product: Sqale neutral-atom quantum computer (plus quantum clocks and RF sensors)

quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion 8-K (updated Q2 2026 results): Q2 revenue was updated to $13.5 million, up 157% year over year (100% organic, entirely from quantum), from the $12.6 million first reported, after Infleqtion identified an immaterial adjustment related to two government contracts that shifted the timing of revenue recognition between periods, offset by lower revenue recognized in 2024 and 2025, with no impact to cash; GAAP operating loss $29.9 million and non-GAAP operating loss $16.2 million (Q2 2025: $7.6 million). CEO Matt Kinsella: 'Q2 was a record quarter for Infleqtion, we remain on track for 30 logical qubits this year'.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue $13.5 million (+157%), updated from $12.6 million

quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion 8-K: full-year 2026 revenue outlook updated to approximately $45.1 million from $43 million to include non-cash, accounting-based revenue adjustments; there are no changes to the assumptions underlying the company's 2026 business expectations, and operating cash flow and cash are unchanged from the August 12 release.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue outlook approximately $45.1 million (from $43 million)
